description: Golden Q&A set for RAGAS evaluation of the AuditSys AI financial/audit RAG agent. ground_truth is the reference answer used for faithfulness/answer_relevancy/context_recall scoring; contexts are populated at eval time from the live retriever unless overridden here.

items.question: What is the total revenue reported for the most recent fiscal year?
items.ground_truth: Total revenue for the most recent fiscal year is stated in the income statement of the ingested annual report.

items.question: What is the company's net income for the current reporting period?
items.ground_truth: Net income for the current reporting period is disclosed on the consolidated income statement.

items.question: What were the total operating expenses last quarter?
items.ground_truth: Total operating expenses for last quarter are broken out in the operating expense note of the filing.

items.question: Does the audit report contain a going concern qualification?
items.ground_truth: The going concern status is stated explicitly in the auditor's opinion section of the audit report.

items.question: What internal control deficiencies were identified in the most recent audit?
items.ground_truth: Identified control deficiencies are listed in the internal controls / management letter section of the audit report.

items.question: What is the current ratio based on the latest balance sheet?
items.ground_truth: The current ratio is current assets divided by current liabilities, both reported on the latest balance sheet.

items.question: Who is the engagement partner listed on the audit opinion?
items.ground_truth: The engagement partner's name appears in the signature block of the audit opinion letter.

items.question: What accounting standard framework was used to prepare the financial statements?
items.ground_truth: The framework (e.g. US GAAP or IFRS) is disclosed in the basis of presentation note.

items.question: Were there any related-party transactions disclosed in the filing?
items.ground_truth: Related-party transactions, if any, are disclosed in the related-party transactions note.

items.question: What is the total value of vendor payments flagged for missing dual approval?
items.ground_truth: The total value of flagged vendor payments is summarized in the procurement exceptions report.

items.question: What is the effective tax rate for the period?
items.ground_truth: The effective tax rate is disclosed in the income tax note as a percentage of pre-tax income.

items.question: What material weaknesses, if any, were reported in internal control over financial reporting?
items.ground_truth: Material weaknesses are described in the ICFR assessment section of the filing.

items.question: What is the total long-term debt outstanding at period end?
items.ground_truth: Total long-term debt is reported on the balance sheet and detailed in the debt note.

items.question: Were any subsequent events disclosed after the balance sheet date?
items.ground_truth: Subsequent events are disclosed in the subsequent events note, if applicable.

items.question: What is the policy threshold requiring dual approval for procurement transactions?
items.ground_truth: The dual-approval threshold is defined in the procurement policy document.

items.question: What was the auditor's overall opinion type (unqualified, qualified, adverse, disclaimer)?
items.ground_truth: The opinion type is stated at the top of the auditor's report.

items.question: What is the gross margin percentage for the most recent fiscal year?
items.ground_truth: Gross margin percentage is gross profit divided by revenue, both on the income statement.

items.question: Are there any pending litigation matters disclosed in the notes?
items.ground_truth: Pending litigation is disclosed in the commitments and contingencies note.

items.question: What is the cash and cash equivalents balance at period end?
items.ground_truth: Cash and cash equivalents balance is reported on the balance sheet.

items.question: What vendor onboarding exceptions were identified and what is their status?
items.ground_truth: Vendor onboarding exceptions and their remediation status are listed in the vendor onboarding exceptions report.
